info.name: ZARI ERP API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the ZARI ERP backend (Express + PostgreSQL + Drizzle).

  **Setup**
  1. Set the `baseUrl` variable (default: http://localhost) to your server origin.
  2. Run the **Auth › POST /auth/login** request with admin credentials — its test script auto-captures the JWT into the `token` variable, which all protected requests use via `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

  **Defaults**
  - Admin user: `admin@example.com` / `YourPasswordHere`
  - All endpoints are mounted under `/api`.

  Generated from `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/` — 433 endpoints across 45 modules.
